messages.subject_clean: Turn my code into a loop
messages.body_plain:
This example is extremely complex, and also does not run due to syntax errors. It would take a lot of time to try and understand what precisely you are trying to do here, someone else might have time for that but not me unfortunately. So I wanted to make two more fundamental points that you might find useful.

1) If you are simply making a survey, why use Shiny? There are many other tools already built to make surveys and collate responses, could be much faster.

2) If you must use Shiny, see if you can trim down your example code to make a minimal working example of the precise question you are asking, without anything extraneous. You may find that in the process of making such a minimal example you actually solve the problem yourself - if not, the example will now be in a form that others can run, easily follow, and give you more helpful responses.

Samuel
